metadata.methods_description: Electrophysiological recordings were conducted using Micromed LTM64 equipment (sampling frequency ≥256 Hz) with 8-channel EEG (FP1, FP2, T3, T4, C3, C4, O1, O2; reference Cz, ground at mastoids), bipolar ECG (lead II), and bipolar EMG (corrugator supercilii muscle). Each session included three phases: pre-intervention baseline (eyes closed or fixed), Music-Assisted Relaxation intervention, and post-intervention recovery. Pain was assessed using Visual Analog Scale (0-10), and anxiety-depression using the Colombian version of the Hospital Anxiety and Depression Scale (HADS).
